lines.en: That pink bloom on my back sways as I walk.

lines.zh: 我穿过草甸，留下一路香
lines.en: I cross the meadow leaving scent behind.
In the flower forest, I'm the easiest to spot.
My hooves are light among the flowers.
One step, one sway of my flower.
A pink flower grows on my back.
Bees have followed me a while.
The meadow grass is tender.
Chewing as I walk, slowly.
This pink looks better with a breeze.

lines.zh: 我绕开开得最密的地方
lines.en: I skirt the thickest blooms.
I know the paths of the flower forest.
Standing here, the bees come.
My bloom is bigger than the rest.
I low, and my flower doesn't tremble.
The sun is just right on the meadow.
I touch the flower with my nose.

lines.zh: 这朵粉花，是我身上长的
lines.en: This pink flower grew on me.
Few visitors come to the flower forest.
Two tail swishes to shoo flies.
My belly's all grass.
Flower on my back, bugs on the flower.
I don't mind them staying.
This meadow could feed me a long while.
The wind carries my scent far.
I'm more of a flower bed than a cow.
Cloudy skies close my flower up.

lines.zh: 我低头，闻到自己身上的甜
lines.en: Head down, I smell my own sweetness.
Other cows look at me oddly.
I rather like being this way.
You're staring at my flower.
This one isn't for picking.

lines.zh: 你的袖口沾着青草的气味。
lines.en: Your sleeve carries the smell of green grass.
Low; so you're new here.
Bees circling you; stay still.

lines.zh: 花森林的花，不是我种的
lines.en: I didn't plant these flowers.
That one by your feet, I just stepped past.
You don't look here to graze.
The pink's pretty, isn't it?
I'm gentle, but the flower is off-limits.
You smiled, and the bees flew off.
Stand back so I can see you.
My flower got knocked off.
Low! That really hurt.
I stepped back half a pace; the flower's still there.
Petals on the ground.
Cows fear pain too.
The bees scattered.
I can't have blood on me.
Pain makes me lower my head.

lines.zh: 你打的这一下，我记在账上。
lines.en: That blow goes on your account.
My low was long.
Wheat? I'll take it.
That bunch in your hand is glaringly pink.
I'll follow; don't trample flowers.
My flower could use some water too.
Grass tastes sweeter than flowers.
Closer; my neck is short.

lines.zh: 我低着头，一步一步挪近。
lines.en: Head low, I shuffle closer step by step.
The bees love this smell too.
One bite, just one.
Scatter it; I'll eat it myself.
You knocked my flower askew.
This body is sturdy.
Step aside; the bees are flying.
My hoof found your foot.
One bump, one petal lost.
I turn slowly; wait.
Don't press against my flower.
The meadow's wide; why bump into me?
A bump doesn't shake me.
The flower held; lucky.
This pink flower is for you.
Two flower cows grazing side by side.
Flowers should bloom on both our backs.
Don't knock my flower off.
The meadow breeze is just right.
One low, and it's settled.
The forest corners are quiet.
Let's guard these flowers together.
Walk on my left; the flower won't block you.

lines.zh: 我们走到哪，蜂群就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever we go, the bees trail us.
A flower fell to the ground.
I lower my head and pick it up.
Tucked back on my back.
This bit of grass, I'll chew it.
Petals all over the ground.
Can't gather them all; I'll take a few.
This one's still fresh.
The bees follow my gathering.
Nothing dropped should be wasted.
My mouth is already full.
I'm rarely fierce, but I can be.

lines.zh: 你靴底下，正踩着我那朵粉花。
lines.en: That pink bloom is under your boot right now.
I guard the flowers of this forest.
Head down, horns forward.
The bees are already circling you.
I stamp once; hear it clearly.
This butt is for my flower.
Step back, and the flower remains.
The cow temper is up.
Don't push me; my hooves are heavy.
I fix on you and low.
I've trampled the flowers crooked.

lines.zh: 你挪一步，我的蹄子就压一步。
lines.en: Each step you take, my hoof answers.
The pink flower on my back trembles.
I'm slow, but always toward you.
Nowhere to hide in this meadow.
The bees' hum grows louder.
I'm figuring where you'll retreat.
One step closer and it starts.
My hoof scraping is a warning.
One butt, and the flowers shake.
My hoof lands loud.
There are horns under the pink.
I charge, and the grass goes flat.

lines.zh: 你推我一下，我还你三下
lines.en: One shove from you, three from me.

lines.zh: 花掉了一片，我记你头上
lines.en: A petal fell; it's on you.
Two charges in a row.
The bees are helping too.
This sends you far back.
I'm not a fighting cow.
The pink flower on my back opens first.
A bit more pink on the meadow.

lines.zh: 粉色花丛里，我撑着腿起身。
lines.en: I push myself up out of the pink blooms.
The bees came first; then me.
This flower forest suits me.
One low, and I'm here.
The grass I tread will grow again.
There's a sweetness in the air.
Pollen on my hooves.

lines.zh: 我这一身，像移动的花圃
lines.en: I'm like a walking flowerbed.
My scent arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 花森林的花，又多了一朵
lines.en: The flower forest has one more bloom.
The pink charred at once.
Rolled downhill, and my flower bent.
Water up to my back; the flower's nearly gone.
Petals blown everywhere.
Something struck my flower.
The flower wilted in an instant.
The meadow's empty; I'm starving.
Lightning hit my back and scorched the flower.
The ground's gone, and the flower can't stay.
